original_contribution: Original same-SQLite-database transactional outbox feature, immutable task-graph preparation, stable nested chord and result identities, and graph-wide atomic publication through a transaction-participating SQLite bulk enqueue API. Independent behavioral verifier and reference implementation.

sources.finding: Existing on_commit_task registers a Django in-memory transaction callback. It is adjacent public functionality, not durable same-file staging through process death.
Existing groups/chords/nested chords/pipelines and result-handle semantics are present. Ordinary enqueue publishes members individually and mutates generated chord configuration.
Current SQLite storage has ordinary individual enqueue and database transaction primitives; no external caller-transaction bulk enqueue or outbox API.
Latest release improvements in error/skipped chord outcomes and SQLite storage must be preserved rather than proposed as new work.
Adjacent public scheduled-message enqueue-loss report already has a response in the pinned HEAD. This is an original business-transaction outbox, not a stale checkpoint restoration of that bug.

public_solution_overlap.known: Existing on_commit_task and ordinary graph APIs are explicitly retained. No outbox API/table found in inspected current source; bounded GitHub repository outbox issue search returned zero results.
public_solution_overlap.limit: Bounded current repository/source/issues/PR search recorded in research/huey-sources.json; not an exhaustive global fork search.

horizon.rationale: Requires preserving caller transaction ownership and savepoints while separating graph preparation from execution; freezing serialized invocations, nested chord coordination and result descriptors; durable key conflict detection; atomic graph publication and concurrent/crashed publisher recovery; immediate mode, serializer, expiry and legacy data compatibility. Actual trajectories must establish sustained work rather than inferring steps from patch size.

validation.local_oracle: 192 passed with zero skips/errors:28 independent feature cases and164 selected upstream regression cases. Two reference-added public tests also passed.
validation.untouched_baseline: Missing huey.contrib.sqlite_outbox causes collection error and reward0.
validation.harbor_validation: Current accepted Harbor oracle/nop results and exact revision bindings are maintained in ../../research/shortlist.json; local construction runs below remain historical evidence.

limitations: Same on-disk main SQLite database only; no cross-database or distributed transaction guarantee.
Atomic publication does not change existing worker delivery semantics or guarantee exactly-once external effects.
Supported graphs are finite trees, with explicit rejection of shared nodes/duplicate IDs/already-bound chord fragments.
Idempotency requires stable explicit task IDs after reconstruction and serialized-content stability; published keys/receipts are retained indefinitely.
Receipt result handles support ordinary reading but do not preserve task arguments for rescheduling.
Docker oracle verified on ARM64; base image supports AMD64 but that platform was not independently run.
